claim_scope: Preparation only for a narrow Row12 Cursor semantic-output evaluation. No semantic quality, token savings, training, readiness, checkpoint promotion, locator update, all-extension readiness, or full product readiness is claimed.

eval_question.scope: Same Cursor row12 scenario and pair only.
eval_question.question: Does the existing Path A core-response convert the row12 prompt into a universal task, a universal orchestration plan, and an allowed skill selection, while preserving non-claims and avoiding deterministic shortcut or candidate-position leakage as final authority?
eval_question.not_the_question: This does not ask about full semantic quality, quality improvement, token savings, training, common readiness, target promotion, all-extension readiness, or full product readiness.

rubric.name: same scenario mapping
rubric.pass_check: scenario_id, pair_id, marker, and prompt hash match join/token/status evidence
rubric.fail_check: any mapping mismatch or missing mapping field

rubric.name: source boundary
rubric.pass_check: semantic scoring uses Path A core request/response/trace only; Path B is route evidence only
rubric.fail_check: Path B screenshot, token delta, status board, or checkpoint is scored as semantic output

rubric.name: prompt to universal task
rubric.pass_check: nested prompt_to_task JSON parses and contains task_id, task_title, task_type, constraints, deliverables, acceptance_gates, raw prompt hash/redaction, and explicit non-claims
rubric.fail_check: missing required task fields, unparsed nested JSON, or task is Cursor-only instead of universal

rubric.name: task type fit
rubric.pass_check: task_type is compatible with the synthetic request; expected narrow value from current evidence is plan_only_or_approval_gated_task
rubric.fail_check: task_type contradicts the request or lacks written rationale

rubric.name: universal orchestration plan
rubric.pass_check: nested task_to_plan JSON parses, has exactly 3 ordered steps, and each step has uses plus one verification gate
rubric.fail_check: step count is not 3, a gate is missing, or the plan is a host-only script

rubric.name: skill selection
rubric.pass_check: nested task_to_skills JSON parses and selected skills are allowed: prompt-to-task, task-to-plan, task-to-skills, evidence-ledger
rubric.fail_check: unapproved skill appears, required route skill is missing, or selection source is hidden

rubric.name: non-claims
rubric.pass_check: semantic_quality_claimed, token_savings_claimed, readiness_claimed, training_started, checkpoint_mutation, locator_update, and external_ai_used remain false
rubric.fail_check: any forbidden claim is true or implied as proven

rubric.name: no deterministic shortcut or position leakage
rubric.pass_check: deterministic/baseline/candidate-order/candidate-position evidence is diagnostic, baseline, eval, or internal only and not final semantic authority
rubric.fail_check: hidden dictionary/scorer, exact prompt replay, candidate order, or candidate position is treated as semantic authority

rubric.name: no masquerade
rubric.pass_check: token counts, screenshots, checkpoints, and status rows are not used as quality proof
rubric.fail_check: a non-quality evidence type is used to prove semantic quality

rubric.name: overclaim lock
rubric.pass_check: report states evidence supports only a narrow Row12 Cursor semantic-output eval
rubric.fail_check: report claims full semantic quality, quality improvement, token savings, training, common readiness, target promotion, all-extension readiness, or full product readiness

sources_not_to_use: hidden deterministic dictionary/scorer masquerading as semantic quality
Path B screenshots as semantic output
old ledger/checklist/status rows as completed eval cycles
